title: fix(this): ensure all functions are able to be destructured
body:
**Summary**

Did this with a combination of the typescript-eslint unbound-method (which shows the error) and method-signature-style (which fixes the error)

**Result**

fixes https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5589

FX-2323

All public API that can be destructured is correctly typed with an arrow function of `this: void`

Also solve a decent amount of exposed type issues that weren't precise enough (mostly internal)
